notes.title: Version 1.12 - Experimental Typing Input Added
notes.content:
Enable in the options menu
Right/Down Arrow - Change typing direction
Esc - Retrieve keys
Space - Play
/ - Place Wild Tile
1 - Place Exclamation Tile

[b]New Challenge Board:[/b]
The Dragons Lair

[b]Features:[/b]
Text recolors with stamps to improve visibility
Completion Tick marks now bigger

Corner tooltip fixed

notes.title: Windows Version 1.11
notes.content:
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
Tiles can now only be triggered max 2x per word

[b]New Challenge[/b]
The Mini

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Hel gives you your turn back when you disable the Sloth
Requirement to start in star tile only applies to first turn
Badges played before quitting save properly
Items created mid match now initialise properly
Cracked Mirror now triggers correctly on double L tile
Infinity on challenge score board records properly

notes.content:

tooltip on unknown items in stats fixed

Paint by  numbers no longer counts blockers
Comedy and Tragedy downside works correctly
Bingo Card now only triggers once per bingo not per word
Selling items properly updates reroll button
3440x1440 resolution added

Shuffler discards increased from 2 => 4

notes.content: Fix for the save bug introduced in the last patch

notes.title: Version 1.09 - Will you take the challenge?
notes.content:
New Challenge mode added.

Play on a special time limited board and compete with users across steam to get the highest score.

(Sorry no bug fixes this week, leaderboard integration took a lot longer than I expected)

notes.title: Windows Version 1.08 - Completionist's Delight
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
Stats Screen shows which items are locked with a hint on how to unlock
Difficulties & Boards on the board selection screen now show tooltips with unlock conditions
On the board selection screen ticks will appear next to each completed difficulty for that board
New Relic: Silver Lining

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Ancient Order of Times and Product - Now has a cost
Boar Blockers allow you to join words to them 
Reverse Engineering tooltip clarified for min 3 tiles (not 3 letters)

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
The Corner - Bonus increased from x2 Multi => x3 Multi per corner covered

notes.title: Version 1.07 - Now With Even More Letters
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
Multi Letter Tiles added to the game - find them in Tileboxes
New Board The Linguist - Play with a full set of Multi-Letter tiles
Punctuation can now be found in Tileboxes
New Boon -  Skoll - destroy your tiles
New Uncommon Relic: Whale - Buy even more Tileboxes


[b]Balance Fixes	[/b]
Tile Box Stamp Likelihoods changed to:	
	Points 5% => 4%
	Cash 5% => 4%
	Multi 5% => 4%
	Riveted 3% => 1%
	Hand 3% => 2%
	SuperPoints 2% => 1%
	SuperMulti 2% =>1%
	SuperCash 2% => 1%
	Welder 1% => 0.5%
	Trigger 1% => 0.5%
Bling Draw changed from uncommon to rare

notes.title: Version 1.06 - Tile Boxes Enter The Shop
notes.content:
Version 1.06 Released

New Features:

Tile Boxes are now available for purchase once per shop to add new tiles to your bag
Tile bag is now visible in the shop to see what you have
(Expect more support for tile bag manipulation strategies in the future)

Bug Fixes;
Stats button now works correctly
Cancelled golden boons stay golden
Inner Eye now correctly selects the longest inner word
Swear jar no longer locks up game

Balancing Fixes:
Number of Cash Stickers on the investor increased from 10 => 16

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.content:
Balance Changes
Final Boss is now easier
Serpent easier multiplier
Ad Nauseam now starts at +4 Multi
Checklist now gives +20 Points badges
Dentures - Now rare and effect changed to x1 Multi increases by 0.5 each time it eats a relic
Double Vision - is now Rare
Egg - Countdown reduced to 6
Five! - is now uncommon
Free Pass - is now Rare
Hive -is now uncommon
Magic Spelling - Now adds 2 ? Tiles each round
Side to Side - now gives +3 points per column
Snowball - Only gives 1 badge
The Edge - is now x6 Multi
Mark of 6  - is now +20 Multi
Up and Down - now gives +3 points per column
Cash Stickers - now only give 1 cash
Cash Stamps - now give 2 cash
Multiplier Stamps - now give 6 Multi
Points Stamps - now give 12 points

Features
Added 2560 x 1440

Bug Fixes
Secret thing now works properly
Serpent now disables properly
